scope: control-only immutable source payload plus separate mode-editable state and acyclic replace_fault_source_payload history

proposed_work_order.fixed_operation_semantics: historical operation name; updates editable state only, never immutable source payload, source record, axes or source identity
proposed_work_order.future_mapping: T1 only, fresh same-candidate source-backed lossless mapping into CandidateStatePackageV5Next

source_record.source_payload_ref_type: Union{Nothing,G3ControlSourcePayloadRefV1} in state; present ref is exact derivation of immutable payload

state.present_rule: source_payload_ref, editable_body and initial_source_content_hash are present; absence fields are nothing
state.absent_rule: source_payload_ref, editable_body and initial_source_content_hash are nothing; absence reason/hash present; contract_admission exactly terminal_deferred; no edit allowed
state.initial_status_rule: state_status, contract_admission and physical_resolution are included in initial_state_hash and initial hash is frozen

operation_record.operation_hash_recipe: H(canonical(operation_id, operation_kind, key, fault_id, expected_prior_mode, resulting_mode, previous_state_hash, expected_prior_source_content_hash, source_payload_ref))
operation_record.state_hash_recipe: H(canonical(key, state_status, source_payload_ref, editable_body_after, initial_source_content_hash, initial_state_hash, previous_state_hash, prior_operation_hashes_in_order, operation_hash, contract_admission, physical_resolution))
operation_record.duplicate_rejection: operation_id, operation_hash and fault_id+previous_state_hash are globally unique; each previous_state_hash must equal the prior state hash; history order is immutable

hash_layers: source_record_hash excludes itself and every source/content/operation/state hash
source_content_hash covers complete immutable payload and source_record_hash and excludes itself
initial_state_hash covers status, source ref/body or typed-absent marker, zero operation and initial statuses and is frozen
operation_hash excludes resulting_state_hash and links previous_state_hash; resulting_state_hash is computed afterward from prior operation hashes and the new operation hash
required_negative_controls: foreign candidate/parent/key/contract/source/axis or source record -> fail_closed
wrong field order/type, open body, duplicate IDs, bad refs, direction/unit/cardinality/controller/fault/plan mismatch -> fail_closed
missing provenance -> typed_absent and terminal_deferred without fabricated source/child hash
independent recomputation of source-record, source-content, initial-state, operation and resulting-state hashes
valid mode-only edit preserves source payload/ref, source record, axes, source and initial hashes
stale source/state, forged hashes, changed non-mode or multi-fault field, unsupported mode, duplicate/reordered history -> fail_closed with prior state bytes unchanged
typed-absent edit, dynamic path, insert/delete/rebind and old V5/package/registry/T0/realization/binding/feedback substitution -> rejected
review_requirement: different Luna independently reviews R3 before any implementation dispatch
